methods.name: dqn
methods.label: DQN
methods.description: Deep Q-network: one network estimates the value of each action.

methods.name: ddqn
methods.label: Double DQN
methods.description: DQN where a second network values the chosen action, which curbs over-optimistic estimates.

methods.name: dueling_ddqn
methods.label: Dueling Double DQN
methods.description: Double DQN whose network separates the value of the state from the advantage of each action.

methods.name: ppo
methods.label: PPO
methods.description: Proximal Policy Optimization: learns action probabilities directly, with clipped updates.
